title: I made a game called Strain. You culture pathogens in a petri dish. It's weirdly addictive.
author: chopjohnGames
selftext:
The main objective is to tap and fuse your specimens, gain research and ultimately win the Nobel prize. There's a game jam going on right now, so would love to get some plays and feedback.

AI discIosure:  I used Claude to help with the heavy code lifting. I designed the UI myself. The specimens were procedurally created using trigonometric functions and parametric curves. No AI image generation is involved anywhere in the rendering pipeline.

If you wanna check it out, here's the link (and thank you!). The game is published on Run.Game. You should be able to play on PC or mobile.

[https://run.game/chopjohn/strain?gamename=strain](https://run.game/chopjohn/strain?gamename=strain)

comments.author: enricokern
comments.body: nice idea. looks also good. How did you get the idea you want to make a game about stuff in a petri dish? 😄

replies.author: chopjohnGames
replies.body:
I wanted to build a game that I knew AI could render procedurally. I also wanted to build an idle game that tapped into a player's desire to collect rare species. Then I thought about how microorganisms naturally mutate. And some of these mutations are really rare. I personally love hard scifi, so I thought this would be a cool idea. I tested out the procedural art and loved it, and the rest is history.   
  
Finding the core game loop was the most difficult part. I basically started over twice because I didn't think my original core game loops were fun.

comments.author: KrustyAnne
comments.body:
Are you thinking of continuing working on this? Spent a few hours on it so far so I was hoping to add a little bit of input.

It can get a little annoying with the strains floating all over the place and overlapping, can be hard to keep track of everything plus sometimes I'll accidentally combine them when trying to click. Was hoping there could be some sort of toggle where you could just have them still in 10 tiles, maybe with the 1:2 1:300 stats and the sell options already showing in the tiles because sometimes I just want to view or sell without accidentally triggering a mutation or multiplication. Maybe instead of having to click on them for points, they all have a certain amount of passive income per second?

Maybe some more direction on how the mechanics work would also be good, like a sort of "?" tab with common game mechanics. I don't understand the publish research mechanic or what gives me prestige points.

Perhaps a slight change in the mutation mechanics since it can be a little disheartening when something goes down in rarity because of a random mutation. Or maybe even rid of the that mechanic entirely? Instead of making them mutate, maybe have a sort of mechanic where the offspring has a certain change to have the same, better, or worse traits than the parent cell. 

Also, I don't see the incentive of having various different types of microbes except for the diversity multiplier, especially since they all have the same traits. Maybe each higher microbe type can have a higher multiplier of income (if it doesn't since I haven't checked) or even have less available microbes and instead of getting either/ or when combining them, make them turn into something new altogether? Would be cool being able to see very unique combinations from combining the right kind of microbes.

This game really got my attention and as an avid idle/ incremental game player, I think this concept has a lot of potential. Just putting a bunch of feedback cause I'm already falling in love with this concept of a game so I'd love to continue to see where it goes.

replies.author: chopjohnGames
replies.body:
Hi. First of all, thank you so much for your suggestions. I'm happy you're enjoying the game. Yes, I am continuing to work on the game, and I'll definitely take a lot of your feedback into consideration. In particular, I don't like that a mutation could make the specimen go down in rarity. I understand why that could happen if you fuse two specimens together when one is a lower rarity and the other one is a higher rarity. That's the risk. But random mutations should always be equivalent or higher. 

I also agree that some of the higher-cost specimens should give you something like a multiplier on research. I'll look into that. 

I also like your idea of more passive income versus having to tap. I know we do have a lab upgrade that auto-taps, but what you're referring to is something different. It's not a tap at all, but rather just passive research income. 

This shouldn't really be overlapping as they move because they have magnetism on them, but if it's still happening, that means I need to push that a little bit more. I can also make them move around just a little bit less as well, so they're not so annoying to tap lol.

comments.author: JenniAlexis
comments.body:
Hello 🙋🏼‍♀️ I just started playing a couple of days ago, and you are right! Very addictive. I just wanted to ask - after downloading the app and getting a new lab, I lost my test tube, lightbulb and beaker. I tried playing through the browser and it's the same. Did the game have an update, or have I done something wrong? Here is what my screen currently looks like.

https://preview.redd.it/8jp7772gwhah1.jpeg?width=1080&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=4471b8b3570af864f59b8b36ad809ab7b165eecd

replies.author: chopjohnGames
replies.body: That's the tutorial screen. Once you get past the tutorial, the UI element should come back. If they don't, can you send me the screenshot of what you see after you get past the tutorial?

replies.author: JenniAlexis
replies.body: Of course! I must have started myself over again somehow. I will provide an update shortly, and thank you for the quick response! I've really been enjoying the game!

replies.author: chopjohnGames
replies.body: Awesome that you're enjoying the game. I would like to get to the bottom of why you somehow started over. It could be because you downloaded the app and created an account. If you were playing through the browser before that, then unfortunately you would lose your progress. But if you've created an account, then you'll no longer lose your progress, so hopefully you're okay. :)

replies.author: JenniAlexis
replies.body:
You are correct, I did lose progress after downloading the app and making an account. That's on me. It shouldn't take too long to get back to where I was. I passed the tutorial and have my equipment back, success! Thank you again 🫶
